name: revEnge Aoki Ketsuzoku no Fukushuu
source:
The main character Ryo seeks training from the beautiful Miyu to become an assassin, in order to get revenge on the criminal syndicate that is responsible for the murder of his younger sister. He will also need to take some of the female members of the syndicate hostage...

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=497&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
主角凉寻求美丽的美优的训练，成为一名刺客，以便向谋杀他妹妹的犯罪集团报仇。他还需要劫持该集团的一些女性成员作为人质……

[来自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=497&style=alphabetical]动漫电传[/url]]
